summary.text: Seth Howard is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 30B, in Anne Arundel County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A military veteran and former small-business owner, he has served in the House since 2015 and sits on the Economic Matters Committee.

paragraphs.text: Howard graduated from Glenelg High School in 1992 and served four years in the U.S. Marine Corps and four years in the Maryland National Guard.
He owned Broadleaf Tobacco and Smoke Shop in Severna Park from 2004 to 2025.
Howard was first elected to the House of Delegates in 2014 and has been a member since 2015.
He sits on the Economic Matters Committee and its Economic Development, Unemployment Insurance, and Business Regulation subcommittees, and has been Deputy Minority Whip since 2021.
He served on the State Commission on the Capitol City from 2015 to 2019 and is a member of the Maryland Veterans Caucus.
